attempts.summary: Repaired node1’s upload endpoint on TCP 8080. It accepts raw bodies through 65536 bytes, atomically creates a unique receipt per accepted request, returns 413 above the limit, returns 404 for other paths, and leaves no receipt for interrupted bodies. The original prior.bin receipt, RHEL 7.9 release, and 3.10 kernel were preserved. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification.
